Title: The Summoning + Paths in Two Worlds/Shroud Mastery

Messages.Author: Krusti
Messages.Body:
Can I play The Summoning at PRE and either Paths in Two Worlds or Shroud Mastery as the action is announced, if my recruit action will be a wraith or zombie in the first case or a wraith in the second?

Action
Summoning, The
+1 stealth action.
Presence Search your library for an ally or retainer. Show it to all players and put it in your hand (shuffle and discard afterward).
Superior Presence Search your library for an ally. This vampire recruits that ally (requirements and cost apply as normal). Shuffle afterward.

Action modifier
Paths in Two Worlds
Only usable as an action to recruit or employ a wraith or zombie is announced.
Oblivion +1 stealth, even if stealth is not yet needed.
Superior Oblivion As above, and if the action is successful, this vampire can burn 1 blood to unlock after action resolution.

Action Modifier
Shroud Mastery
Necromancy Only usable by a ready vampire other than the acting wraith. The acting wraith gets +1 stealth.
Superior Necromancy Only usable as an action to recruit or employ a wraith is announced. Unlock this vampire after action resolution if this action is successful.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Krusti wrote:
> Can I play The Summoning at PRE and either Paths in Two Worlds or Shroud Mastery as the action is announced, if my recruit action will be a wraith or zombie in the first case or a wraith in the second?
>
You can't, because even though The Summoning is a recruit action, the type of ally recruited is not set when announcing the action.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: lip
Messages.Body: “A retainer requiring animalism” (Muricia) is not the same as “an animal retainer” (Tainted). So, your question is moot I guess.
